scientific_integrity: Analytical argument with independently implemented numerical consistency checks; no claim of independent formal or external certification.
scientific_limitations: The universal statement is limited to compactly supported rotation-invariant hyperplane-null measures and continuous nonnegative nondecreasing Euclidean distance weights. The exact offset and high-dimensional formulas apply only to uniform unit-sphere pairs with Euclidean chord weight; they do not improve unrestricted worst-case constants. Historical priority is provisional.
title: Centered hyperplane optimality for radial distance-weighted cuts
